headline: Bitcoin faces downside pressure following security breach at Binance
summary: Bitcoin faces heightened downside risks as market fear surges in the wake of a security breach at cryptocurrency exchange Binance.
why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization, and security incidents at major exchanges frequently impact liquidity and crypto valuations.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Security breaches at major exchanges sap trader sentiment and spark immediate selling across crypto assets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: News of a security breach at Binance sparked risk aversion, putting downward pressure on Bitcoin prices.
